subject: Life Skills
title: Umbrella Policies Explained
description: A fast breakdown of Umbrella Policies Explained for builders.

hook.text: A teenager's car accident caused injuries costing $2 million. The family's auto policy maxed at $300,000.

buildup.text: Standard auto and home policies have liability caps. Major incidents can exceed them dramatically.

discovery.text: An umbrella policy adds extra liability coverage on top of your existing policies for a low annual cost.

twist.text: A million-dollar umbrella policy often costs less than $200 per year. It's the cheapest coverage per dollar.

climax.text: If you have assets to protect, an umbrella policy prevents a lawsuit from wiping out everything.

punchline.text: Two hundred dollars protects a million. Worth it.

quiz.question: What does an umbrella insurance policy do?
options: Replaces your auto and home insurance
Adds extra liability coverage above existing policies
